title: Rangeland vegetation cover (RAP / rangeland-s2)
description: Vegetation cover estimates for rangelands across the contiguous United States, derived from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery through the Rangeland Analysis Platform (RAP). The dataset provides fractional cover metrics (e.g. bare ground, annual/perennial forbs and grasses, shrubs, trees) at high spatial resolution as cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs.
